# A test corpus. NOT a pack anyone should use.
#
# weirsmith ships no word data — it converts the dictionaries you bring. These
# words exist only so the suite can build a real pack, load it into a real
# Harper, and check that the machinery works. Every one was verified missing in
# all five dialects on 2026-07-25 (`weirsmith probe --dialect all`); if a future
# Harper learns one, the "genuinely unknown" test says so and it should be
# swapped for another, not deleted.
#
# Nothing here is chosen for usefulness. Each entry pays for its place:
#
#   affix coverage      one base per affix branch, because the branches differ.
#                       `S` on a consonant, `S` on a lowercase y (-> -ies), `S`
#                       on an UPPERCASE Y (a different character class), `G` on
#                       an e-final verb (drops the e) and on a consonant-final
#                       one, plus `g`, `m`, `~J` and `~N`.
#   junk-filter corpus  legitimate tokens that mix letters and digits. A regex
#                       tuned to reject `0b00b135` very easily rejects
#                       `DCB0129` as well — every word here must survive
#                       sanitize(), asserted in test/core.test.js.
#
# Flags: ~ common  N noun  O proper noun  V verb  J adjective
#        m mass (no plural)  g possessive 's  S plural  G -ing  d -ed

# --- affix branches
kubelet/~NgS          # S after a consonant; g possessive
formulary/~NgS        # S after a lowercase y -> formularies
kubectl/~Nmg          # mass noun, no plural at all
deprescribe/~VGdS     # G on an e-final verb -> deprescribing, not deprescribeing
rerender/~VGdS        # G on a consonant-final verb
SLO/OgS               # proper noun that pluralises
QALY/OgS              # S after an UPPERCASE Y — a different branch to formulary
Istio/Og              # proper noun, no plural
nosocomial/~J         # adjective
sequelae/~N           # already plural, takes no further S
protobuf/~NgS
oximetry/~Nmg

# --- letter/digit tokens the junk filter must not reject
NEWS2/Og              # trailing digit
HL7/Og                # trailing digit, short
S3/Og                 # one letter, one digit — the shortest hard case
GP2GP/Og              # digit in the middle
DCB0129/Og            # every character is a hex digit; four digits
ISO13485/Og           # letters then a long digit run
IEC62304/Og
Route53/Og
log4j/~Nmg            # lowercase, digit in the middle
utf8mb4/~Nmg          # two separate digit runs
a11y/~Nmg             # numeronym: letter, digits, letter
